title: İmbikten Kadehe
author: Burkay Adalığ
description: This essential companion uncovers the heritage and craft behind vodka, gin, rum, cognac, tequila, and Turkey’s beloved rakı. Adalığ explains fermentation, distillation, raw materials, and cocktail-making basics, while also offering a visual comparison of nearly 50 rakı brands. Both technical reference and cultural guide, this book celebrates distilled spirits in all their diversity.
english_title: From Still to Glass: The World of Distilled
